mapper.select: with now_task_b as ( select * from ( select hours_add( date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'), unnest) as start_time , hours_add( date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'), unnest+1) as stop_time , #{now} as now_time from ( select array_generate(0, 23, 1) as index_ )f, unnest(index_) as unnest )c1 where now_time BETWEEN start_time and stop_time ) select tc.id, tc.task_id, tc.channel_id, tc.client_id, tc.data_type, tc.status, tc.start_time, tc.stop_time, tc.tid from alt_task_execution_record tc , now_task_b b where tc.stop_time BETWEEN b.start_time and b.stop_time and status = '1'
